title: Cold rebuild: Quarterly view
summary: Rebuild Quarterly view from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Quarterly view** in *Concat and reshaping*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.explain: `sales` and `revenue` do not match, so each becomes its own column, half empty: two NaNs in total. Rename before you concat.

steps.title: Rebuild Quarterly view cold
prompt: Write `quarterly(wide)` for a wide table with a `store` column and the month columns `jan` ... `jun`. Return a **wide** DataFrame with one row per store (the index) and columns `Q1` (jan to mar) and `Q2` (apr to jun) holding total sales.
Melt to long, map each month to its quarter, sum by store and quarter, then pivot back.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
